openFindings.problem: The trusted finalizer's Android API 35 emulator step still uses a multi-line script: | block. reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 splits the block into individual lines and executes each via sh -c; the first line set -euo pipefail is invalid under dash (/bin/sh on Ubuntu) and exits 2, so the step fails before APK install and golden path ever run. Same root cause as finalizer runs 35293489693, 35302658175 and 35315519533. Candidate delta is one test file and does not change the workflow, so the blocker persists; the next finalizer run will fail identically even if the expo version fix above passes.
openFindings.evidence: Current HEAD workflow shows script: | with set -euo pipefail, apk=$(find ...), adb install, npm run e2e:android (lines 90-94). Pristine accepted tree has identical workflow (diff vs pristine shows no workflow change). Local reproduction: sh -c 'set -euo pipefail' -> exit 2 (dash), bash -c 'set -euo pipefail' -> exit 0. Action source v2.33.0 lib/script-parser.js + lib/main.js line 208-211 confirms line-split via sh -c. scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh exists in baseline (1155 bytes, bash -n OK) but is never invoked.
openFindings.requiredFix: Trusted shell (workflows are protected control-plane files; Builder cannot edit them): on main, replace the emulator step's multi-line script: | block with the single-line script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh, then re-run the trusted finalizer. Wrapper already contains complete APK locate/install + golden-path logic in one bash process. No additional product code change needed for this item.
